title: fix(service-automation): stable notify warning text and a per-text bound on run summary warnings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_

Fixes #33500
Fixes #33380

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`notify` 节点的投递失败警告不再带次数;`stepAdvisoriesOf` 注释收窄为实情(仅注释);运行摘要里每条警告文本限长 300 字符(带截断标记);步骤日志类型对齐钉子补上 `warnings` / `droppedFields`。
- 为什么改:循环里每轮收件人数不同,同一原因生成多条不同文本,摘要去重失效、5 条名额被近似重复占满;超长文本可能把摘要挤过 16 KB 上限而丢掉整张节点表。
- 风险与回滚:只改运行时字符串与摘要截断,不动 spec 与契约;次数仍在节点 output(`failed`/`delivered`/`enqueued`);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-summary.ts`(截断位置在去重之前)、`builtin/notify-node.ts`(文本改写)、`builtin/region-index-keys.test.ts`(类型钉子)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/run-summary.test.ts src/builtin/notify-delivery-outcome.integration.test.ts`,预期全绿,循环用例摘要只剩一条警告。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Stable notify warning text (#33500 item 1).** `deliveryFailureWarning` (`builtin/notify-node.ts`) no longer puts a count in the step warning: no `(N)`, no `channel 'X' (N deliveries)`, no `N of M deliveries failed`. The text names each failed channel with its own reason and says whether anything got through: `notify delivered nothing: every delivery it attempted failed. channel 'push': ...` or `notify: some deliveries failed while others were delivered or enqueued. channel 'push': ...`. The counts were already on the node output (`failed`, `delivered`, `enqueued`) per execution, so they move out of the text and nowhere else. A looped `notify` whose fan-out varies now raises one text per cause, and the summary row's distinct-text fold reads it as one entry.
- **Per-text bound on summary warnings (#33500 item 2).** `run-summary.ts` cuts each warning text at `MAX_NODE_SUMMARY_WARNING_LENGTH = 300` UTF-16 code units, marker included (` [... cut; the step log holds the full text]`). The bound lives in the summary builder, beside the existing 5-per-node cap, not in each producer. It is applied before the distinct-text fold, so two long texts that agree up to the cut fold into one entry. It never splits a surrogate pair. The step log keeps every text whole.
- **Type pin (#33380).** `builtin/region-index-keys.test.ts` adds `warnings` and `droppedFields` to the invariant `Eq` pin between the engine's `StepLogEntry` and the spec's `ExecutionStepLog`, and corrects the stale comment: `nodeLabel` is the only engine-local field left.
- **Declined: #33500 item 3** (a typed `warningsOmitted: number` in place of the overflow sentence). It is a second widening (`Clause-②: yes`) that needs its own contract review, and the card allows leaving it out once items 1 and 2 hold.
- **Docblock (#33380 N2, area S6 ruling: option A, comment only).** The `stepAdvisoriesOf` docblock in `dag-traversal.ts` said the step and the run's terminal answer "can never disagree" about which drop events were real. It now says they agree on which events were well-typed, and names the one shape where they part: a well-typed event with `fields: []` stays on the step, while `foldDropEvents` drops it from the answer. No in-tree producer emits one. No code changed (commit ab873a6a).

Changeset: `.changeset/33500-notify-warning-stable-bounded.md`, `patch` on `@objectstack/service-automation`.

## Tests

- `run-summary.test.ts`: four new cases. A text past the bound is cut to exactly the bound and ends with the marker. A text at the bound is published whole. Two long texts that agree up to the cut fold into one entry. The cut never splits a surrogate pair. The existing `refused` fixture now uses the new notify text.
- `notify-delivery-outcome.integration.test.ts`: a new case runs a real `MessagingService` behind a `notify` inside a `loop` over three recipient lists (1, 2 and 3 users) on an unregistered `push` channel. A spy on `emit` confirms the fan-out varied (`failed` 1, 2, 3). All three steps carry one identical text, and the parsed `FlowRunSummarySchema` row carries exactly that one warning.
- `region-index-keys.test.ts`: the `_AdvisoryKeysInStep` type pin, compiled by the package `typecheck`.

## Acceptance notes

- A delivery reason can itself name a recipient (`email-channel.ts`: `no email address for recipient 'X'`, `nothing was sent to 'X'`). Per-recipient reasons from the messaging service therefore still give distinct texts per recipient. That text belongs to `service-messaging`, which is outside this card. The 5-entry cap and the new per-text bound keep the row bounded either way.
- The spec `describe` on `FlowRunNodeSummary.warnings` says the list is bounded per node and that the step log holds each execution's own text. It does not mention the per-text cut. That is still true, and `packages/spec` is out of bounds for this PR.

## Verification

All readings were taken at head `00c91332` unless noted. Head `ab873a6a` adds only the comment-only docblock commit on top of it.

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, under the verify lock: `Test Files 282 passed (282)`, `Tests 3982 passed (3982)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Measured at 4fcd45e2, which has the same tree as the head.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Re-checked on the merge head 00c91332 after merging `origin/main`. The merge touched no service-automation source. The dependency closure was rebuilt, then the three touched test files ran (`Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 68 passed (68)`) and the package `typecheck` ran (`check:test-typecheck: OK`), all under the lock with `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored, blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- **Type pin.** The engine's `StepLogEntry.droppedFields` was changed to `Array<DroppedFieldsEvent & { at?: string }>`, an engine-local member the contract does not carry. That shape is still assignable everywhere else. `tsc --noEmit` failed with exactly one error, `src/builtin/region-index-keys.test.ts(76,5): error TS2344: Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'`, which is the new `_AdvisoryKeysInStep`. A first try that widened to `unknown[]` was also caught by `run-history.ts` and `engine.ts` assignability, so the narrower mutation above is the one that isolates the pin.
- **Count back in the notify text** (`failed (${failed})`): the loop case went red with `AssertionError: one text for one cause: expected 3 to be 1`.
- **Bound removed** (`seen.add(warning)`): three cases went red, including `expected '...' to have a length of 300 but got 1217`.
- **Surrogate guard removed**: `never splits a surrogate pair at the cut` went red.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 4fcd45e2 (6 paths vs merge base 1e65a389e). 68 commands were derived.

- 64 ran in one local sweep. 63 exited 0, including `pnpm check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock and `pnpm check:nul-bytes`.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (shallow clone). After `git fetch --depth=1 origin` on its fixture commit it exited 0 with 48 cases.
- The 3 PR-body gates in the derived list ran on this body before the PR was opened, along with `check-partof-closing-keyword`. All exited 0: `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` and `check-partof-closing-keyword`.
